_note: How many surviving children the leave travel concession covers (D-212; rulebook SAL-LTA-CHILD-001): two, not counting children born before 1-10-1998 nor children of a multiple birth after one child. TY 2026-27, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.278(5)–(6) (p.1776); TY 2025-26, Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.2B(4) and its proviso — the rulebook's "r.2B(5),(6)" is wrong (erratum there). The limit falls on children: a journey on which a child beyond it travels keeps the rest of the family's travel exempt, the child's share a nil line. Which counted children are covered the Rules do not say; the two eldest are taken, r.278(6)'s "multiple births after one child" counting children by birth (D-212 C3a, an inference). "Surviving" is read on the journey's start date. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids the concession through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (D-166).
